strengths: The caller ID analogy is mapped precisely onto the causal limit of an AI label (origin versus truth) and then returned to a concrete real-world case, satisfying the familiar-to-technical movement.

The next action is concrete and case-specific (open the original source, check date, line, stations and day) rather than generic 'be careful' advice.
